title: Fine-Grained Selector Store (Zustand / Redux pattern)
problemStatement: Implement `createStore(initialState)` with methods: `getState()`, `setState(partial)`, and `useSelector(selector, equalityFn = Object.is)`. Subscribers are only notified when their selected slice of state actually changes.
interviewTrap: Global state stores that notify all components regardless of which slice changed cause massive app-wide re-render cascades.

testCases.name: Notifies selector subscriber only when selected property changes
testCases.testFn: const store = createStore({ count: 0, text: 'hi' }); const notifications = []; store.subscribeSelector(s => s.count, val => notifications.push(val)); store.setState({ count: 10 }); return notifications;

testCases.name: Does not notify subscriber when unrelated state changes
testCases.input: updating text does not notify counter subscriber
testCases.testFn: const store = createStore({ count: 0, text: 'hi' }); let calls = 0; store.subscribeSelector(s => s.count, () => calls++); store.setState({ text: 'updated' }); return calls;

testCases.name: Unsubscribe cleans up listener properly
testCases.testFn: const store = createStore({ count: 0 }); let calls = 0; const unsub = store.subscribeSelector(s => s.count, () => calls++); store.setState({ count: 1 }); unsub(); store.setState({ count: 2 }); return calls;

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: By default, when a parent component renders, all its child components re-render recursively regardless of whether their props changed. `React.memo` bails out only if all props are shallowly equal.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Initialize execution context and environment records for Selective Re-renders & Subscription Notification.
2. Execute logic adhering to ECMAScript standard specification.
3. Verify invariant boundaries and edge conditions.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In JavaScript engines (e.g. V8), Selective Re-renders & Subscription Notification is optimized via inline caches, heap contexts, and bytecode translation.
edgeCasesHandled: Global state stores that notify all components regardless of which slice changed cause massive app-wide re-render cascades.

verifiedRules: Adheres to ECMAScript runtime evaluation specifications.
